target_orbit: 400 km, 51.6 deg, 5 years, 1.0 g/cm2 Al equivalent

persistent_state.normalization_basis: per stored bit per second; read BER conditioned on 1500 s known-good rewrite interval
limitations: cross-device response envelope, not a confidence interval

transient_read.normalization_basis: per read access while stored state is correct
limitations: sense amplifier, bitline, mux, decoder and control SET cross sections are not available
Qcrit ratio is not an absolute dynamic write cross section or BER
address/control errors, SEFI and MBU are not modeled
TID electrical corners are functional screens, not permanent-failure statistics; displacement damage not propagated
